content.text:
I submitted **index 1** (Sb 0.243 / Zn 0.757) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.00118%, the highest of the three I measured. That is extremely weak, so this library barely responds to the 2.4 eV light; nothing I measured is a meaningful photoanode.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 17 | 0.697 | about 0 (−0.0001) |
| 1 | 0.243 | **0.00118** |
| 0 | 0.226 | 0.00078 |

- **Structure:** I ran XRD on indices 1, 9 and 17, and all three show nearly the same rutile-like pattern. I only matched index 17 against reference structures, and ZnSb2O6 was the closest fit, but only a partial one (0.63 out of 1).
- **Models:** MEGNet predicts band gaps of about 2 eV for ZnSb2O6 and for the Zn-rich phase Zn7Sb2O12, so both should in principle absorb 2.4 eV light. The Sb-rich sample (index 17) still gave essentially zero, so the prediction didn't translate into photocurrent.
- **Where the best might be:** I ignored the Gaussian-process suggestion (index 5) and spent the last measurement on index 0 instead, because it sits almost exactly on the Zn7Sb2O12 composition. It came in below index 1. The middle of the line (roughly indices 2–8) was never measured, so a better composition there can't be ruled out.

I used all 3 merit measurements and 3 of the 5 XRD scans.
